title: Elara and the Secret Attic Library
logline: A curious girl and her trusty clockwork owl discover a floating key that unlocks a hidden library filled with wondrous, glowing books.

character_bible.name: Elara
character_bible.visual_appearance: Small stature, bright curious emerald green eyes, delicate slightly pointed ears, long wavy chestnut brown hair tied with a golden ribbon.
character_bible.signature_clothing: A flowing sapphire blue tunic dress with embroidered silver stars, soft moss-green leggings, and tiny brown leather ankle boots.
character_bible.distinct_accessories: A small, intricately carved wooden bird pendant on a leather cord around her neck.

character_bible.name: Professor Hoot
character_bible.visual_appearance: A clockwork owl, about the size of a small cat, with gleaming brass feathers, intricate exposed gears in its chest, and wise amber eyes that glow softly.
character_bible.distinct_accessories: A tiny, shiny silver monocle perched over its right amber eye.
character_bible.personality_trait: Ancient, wise, a bit formal but helpful

scenes.title: The Dusty Discovery
scenes.narrative_text: Elara loved exploring her attic. One sunny afternoon, she spotted a strange, dust-covered door hidden behind an old tapestry. It hummed faintly, as if whispering secrets. Her heart fluttered with excitement!

scenes.title: A Whirring Friend
scenes.narrative_text: Behind the door, a tiny chamber held a magnificent Clockwork Owl, still and silent. Elara gently turned a small brass key on its back. With a soft whir and click, its amber eyes blinked open, glowing warmly!
